parole.testo: Derived from Ottoman Turkish دنك (deŋk, “equal”), from Proto-Turkic *teŋ, ultimately from Middle Chinese 等 (təŋX, “equal”). See also Bashkir тәңкә (täñkä) for additional information regarding other Turkic cognates.
